correctness.rationale: The graph and Hamming metric are defined explicitly. At scale 2 the missing edges are exactly the categorical-product edges. The packaged Python 3 checker enumerates all 30,992 augmented independent faces and 178,704 cover incidences, constructs 15,448 distinct matched pairs, and topologically sorts the complete reversed-matching Hasse orientation to verify all 30,992 nodes are removed. Exactly 96 unpaired 4-vertex faces remain; an empty-singleton match is removed to yield one ordinary critical 0-cell and 96 critical 3-cells, giving a wedge of 96 three-spheres by discrete Morse theory. Scale 1 is a union of 33 coordinate simplices whose incidence graph has 69 nodes and 108 edges, hence wedge 40 circles. Scale 0 and 3 are elementary. All barcode interval claims follow by degree concentration, not guessed boundary ranks.

value.rationale: This is the smallest unequal triple of complete-graph factors with no binary factor, immediately after the established (3,3,3) case. A reproducible exact homotopy classification proves the first mixed-parameter instance of a published open conjecture and rules out torsion and extra spheres, not just verifying its predicted Euler characteristic. The equivalent complete mixed Hamming-box persistence barcode has 35, 40, and 96 exact bars in three dimensions. This canonical first unresolved case has precise relevance to testing an infinite-family conjecture.
